<function name="AddonMaterial" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Loads the specified image from the `/cache` folder, used in combination with <page>steamworks.Download</page>. Most addons will provide a 512x512 png image.

<note>This works with any image file with the `.cache` file extension, even outside of the `/cache` folder.</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="name" type="string">The name of the file.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="IMaterial">The material, returns `nil` if the cached file is not an image.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
